urn:factur-x.eu:1p0:minimum.label: Factur-X MINIMUM
urn:factur-x.eu:1p0:minimum.note: MINIMUM is not an EN 16931 compliant profile and is not a valid structured invoice for the French B2B mandate.

mandates.name: France - Plateforme Agreee / Factur-X
mandates.note: Every VAT-registered business in France must be able to receive structured e-invoices from 2026-09-01; large and mid-sized companies must also issue from that date, SMEs and micro-enterprises from 2027-09-01. Accepted core formats: Factur-X, UBL 2.1, CII.

mandates.name: Germany - E-Rechnung / XRechnung
mandates.note: Receipt of structured e-invoices is mandatory since 2025-01-01. Issuing becomes mandatory 2027-01-01 for sellers above EUR 800,000 prior-year turnover and 2028-01-01 for everyone else.

mandates.name: Belgium - Peppol B2B
mandates.note: Domestic B2B structured e-invoicing is mandatory since 2026-01-01; the tolerance period ended 2026-03-31 and penalties are enforced. Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 is the reference format.

mandates.name: Poland - KSeF FA(3)
mandates.note: FA(2) was replaced by the FA(3) XML structure on 2026-02-01. KSeF issuing is mandatory from 2026-02-01 above PLN 200m prior-year turnover, from 2026-04-01 for all other VAT payers, and from 2027-01-01 for micro-enterprises.

mandates.name: Spain - Verifactu / SIF
mandates.note: Verifactu was postponed by one year: Corporate Income Tax payers from 2027-01-01 and other taxpayers, including autonomos, from 2027-07-01. A 2026 go-live date is out of date.

mandates.name: Italy - FatturaPA / SdI
mandates.note: Domestic invoices clear through the Sistema di Interscambio in the FatturaPA XML format. UBL and CII are not accepted for domestic Italian invoices.

rules.msg: Root element is not an EN 16931 syntax
rules.fix: Use a UBL 2.1 Invoice/CreditNote or a UN/CEFACT CrossIndustryInvoice document.

rules.msg: Specification identifier (CustomizationID) is missing
rules.fix: Add cbc:CustomizationID naming the EN 16931 CIUS this invoice follows.

rules.msg: Specification identifier is not a profile this linter knows
rules.fix: Check the identifier against the CIUS your receiving platform publishes.

rules.msg: Specification identifier names a retired profile version
rules.fix: Move to the replacement profile.

rules.msg: Invoice number (BT-1) is missing
rules.fix: Add cbc:ID at document level.

rules.msg: Invoice issue date (BT-2) is missing
rules.fix: Add cbc:IssueDate in YYYY-MM-DD form.

rules.msg: Invoice type code (BT-3) is missing
rules.fix: Add cbc:InvoiceTypeCode, normally 380 for a commercial invoice.

rules.msg: Invoice currency code (BT-5) is missing
rules.fix: Add cbc:DocumentCurrencyCode, for example EUR.

rules.msg: Seller legal name (BT-27) is missing
rules.fix: Add cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:RegistrationName under the supplier party.

rules.msg: Seller VAT identifier (BT-31) is missing
rules.fix: Add cac:PartyTaxScheme/cbc:CompanyID with the VAT scheme for the seller.

rules.msg: Seller country code (BT-40) is missing
rules.fix: Add cac:Country/cbc:IdentificationCode in the seller postal address.

rules.msg: Buyer legal name (BT-44) is missing
rules.fix: Add cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:RegistrationName under the customer party.

rules.msg: Buyer country code (BT-55) is missing
rules.fix: Add cac:Country/cbc:IdentificationCode in the buyer postal address.

rules.msg: Invoice total VAT amount (BT-110) is missing
rules.fix: Add cac:TaxTotal/cbc:TaxAmount at document level.

rules.msg: Invoice total without VAT (BT-109) is missing
rules.fix: Add cbc:TaxExclusiveAmount to cac:LegalMonetaryTotal.

rules.msg: Invoice total with VAT (BT-112) is missing
rules.fix: Add cbc:TaxInclusiveAmount to cac:LegalMonetaryTotal.

rules.msg: Amount due for payment (BT-115) is missing
rules.fix: Add cbc:PayableAmount to cac:LegalMonetaryTotal.

rules.msg: Invoice has no invoice line
rules.fix: An EN 16931 invoice needs at least one cac:InvoiceLine.

rules.msg: Sum of invoice line net amounts (BT-106) does not equal the lines
rules.fix: Set cac:LegalMonetaryTotal/cbc:LineExtensionAmount to the sum of the line amounts.

rules.msg: Total with VAT (BT-112) does not equal total without VAT plus VAT
rules.fix: BT-112 must equal BT-109 + BT-110.

rules.msg: Amount due (BT-115) does not equal total with VAT minus prepaid plus rounding
rules.fix: BT-115 must equal BT-112 - BT-113 + BT-114.

rules.msg: Amount due is positive but neither a due date (BT-9) nor payment terms (BT-20) are given
rules.fix: Add cbc:DueDate or cac:PaymentTerms/cbc:Note.

rules.msg: France: seller legal registration identifier (SIREN or SIRET) is missing or is not 9 or 14 digits
rules.fix: Add cac:AccountingSupplierParty/cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:CompanyID with schemeID 0009 (SIRET) or 0002 (SIREN).

rules.msg: France: buyer legal registration identifier (SIREN or SIRET) is missing on a domestic B2B invoice
rules.fix: Add cac:AccountingCustomerParty/cac:PartyLegalEntity/cbc:CompanyID with the buyer SIREN or SIRET.

rules.msg: France: the Factur-X MINIMUM profile is not an EN 16931 compliant invoice
rules.fix: Use Factur-X BASIC or EN 16931 (COMFORT), or UBL 2.1 / CII.

rules.msg: XRechnung: buyer reference (BT-10, the Leitweg-ID) is missing
rules.fix: Add cbc:BuyerReference with the Leitweg-ID the buyer gave you.

rules.msg: XRechnung: seller contact name, telephone and email are required and one of them is missing
rules.fix: Add cac:Contact with cbc:Name, cbc:Telephone and cbc:ElectronicMail under the supplier party.

rules.msg: XRechnung: payment instructions (BG-16) are missing
rules.fix: Add cac:PaymentMeans with cbc:PaymentMeansCode.

rules.msg: Belgium: seller or buyer Peppol electronic address (cbc:EndpointID with a schemeID) is missing
rules.fix: Add cbc:EndpointID schemeID="0208" (Belgian enterprise number) to both parties.

rules.msg: Belgium: the reference format for the domestic B2B mandate is Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 and this invoice declares another profile
rules.fix: Set CustomizationID to the Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 identifier.

rules.msg: Poland: domestic invoices must be filed to KSeF in the FA(3) structure, not UBL or CII
rules.fix: Generate the FA(3) XML for KSeF; keep UBL only for cross-border Peppol exchange.

rules.msg: Poland: this document uses the FA(2) KSeF structure, which was replaced by FA(3)
rules.fix: Regenerate against the FA(3) schema.

rules.msg: Italy: domestic invoices clear through SdI in FatturaPA format, not UBL or CII
rules.fix: Generate FatturaPA XML for domestic Italian invoices.

rules.msg: Spain: Verifactu was postponed by one year - Corporate Income Tax payers from 2027-01-01 and other taxpayers from 2027-07-01
rules.fix: Check any 2026 Verifactu go-live date hard-coded in your billing configuration.

rules.msg: Mandate status for the seller country
rules.fix: No change needed; this line states the dates the other findings are measured against.
